description_en: Queries the summary of sensitive data
name: ListTotalSensitiveInfo

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response description. Valid values:

zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The code of the cloud service. Column encryption supports RDS, POLARDB, and PolarDBX2. If you also specify ProductId, the two values must correspond to each other
parameters.help_zh: 云产品编码。列加密支持 RDS、POLARDB、PolarDBX2；如同时传入 ProductId，二者必须对应
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data classification template. You can obtain this value from Items[].Id in the response of the ListTemplates operation. The value must be consistent with the selected sensitivity level and detection model
parameters.help_zh: 分类分级模板标识，可从 ListTemplates 的 Items[].Id 获取；与所选敏感等级和识别模型保持一致
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en:
The statistics scenario. Valid values:

41: overview.
42: data catalog statistics by product.
43: region and template summary by product
parameters.help_zh: 统计场景。41：总览；42：按产品查询数据目录统计；43：按产品查询地域和模板汇总
parameters.name: count_type

parameters.help_en: Multiple product codes separated by commas (,). This parameter is used when CountType is set to 43 and ProductCode is not specified. The results are merged by region and template
parameters.help_zh: 多个产品编码，以英文逗号分隔。CountType=43 且未提供 ProductCode 时使用；结果按地域和模板合并
parameters.name: product_code_list
